analysis:
Documentation-only changes in docs/architecture/inference.md and docs/developer/test.md. I examined the supplied head text for inference.md (lines 2389-2639, the Flint and Bonsai sections), the test.md base text and patch, and the inference.md patch excerpt. The patch excerpts are truncated; the changed-range maps are complete. The test.md patch adds GLM5Next logprobs, OpenRouter capability and tool/response_format test descriptions. The inference.md patch changes GLM video handling: variable-frame-rate video is now indexed at i / nominalFrameRate instead of being refused with a 400.

No code, controls, endpoints or deployment settings change. No threat-model assumption is invalidated. Relevant boundaries, TB-007 (inference engine and media) and TB-003, are unchanged in documented posture.

Points for a later pass, none of them a finding:
- The VFR video change is described only in docs here. The implementing source (GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset) was not supplied. Bounds such as the 512 MiB maximumDecodedBytes, the frame, token and byte limits, and the 28,532 visual token cap remain documented as retained, but their enforcement cannot be verified from this PR.
- The new tests exercise logprobs capture and the withholding of reasoning and tool output. The docs state that scripted tests prove provider behavior, not model compliance.
- The logprobs path returns per-token entries from the protected native bridge. The GLM and Flint sections state hidden reasoning is withheld, and the Flint logprobs filter drops those entries. The GLM logprobs source was not supplied, so it is unknown whether GLM reasoning is withheld from logprobs.
- Prefix-cache and T-041 semantics are not touched. Media requests stay excluded from prefix lookup and capture per the doc text.
